sentenceIntentions.text: The most reassuring explanation may be the one that stops you asking too soon.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel a productive doubt about reassuring stories

sentenceIntentions.text: Before Explanation examines the moment a useful story hardens into the world we think we know.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the moment when a story becomes assumed reality
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand the book's focus on explanatory closure

sentenceIntentions.text: A failed project, a broken appliance, or an unanswered message can acquire a confident explanation almost immediately.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Give everyday situations that rapidly attract explanations
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize the process in familiar life

sentenceIntentions.text: But the feeling of understanding is different from knowing how something actually happened.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Separate felt understanding from causal knowledge
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Notice that confidence is not itself evidence

sentenceIntentions.text: The book follows that difference through everyday choices, decisions at work, and convincing AI answers.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Move from private judgments to institutions and AI
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: See the same tension across scales

sentenceIntentions.text: It asks what a story leaves out, what else could explain the event, and what could change our minds.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Ask what remains excluded or revisable

sentenceIntentions.text: An explanation begins to earn trust when it leaves room for evidence that might change what we do.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Translate better explanation into revisable action
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Imagine reasons that can change instead of merely reassure

sentenceIntentions.text: Begin with a finished story of your own, and see where its certainty came from.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Invite scrutiny of one's own settled story
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to inspect how personal certainty formed
